name: Alert
summary: +5 to initiative. You can't be surprised while conscious, and creatures you can't see don't get advantage on attacks against you.

name: Athlete
summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Standing up from prone costs only 5 feet of movement, climbing costs no extra movement, and running jumps need only a 5-foot run-up.

name: Actor
summary: +1 Charisma. Advantage on Deception and Performance checks when passing yourself off as someone else, and you can mimic voices and sounds you've heard.

name: Charger
summary: After you Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee attack (+5 damage) or shove a creature, if you moved at least 10 feet straight toward it.

name: Crossbow Expert
summary: Ignore the loading property of crossbows you're proficient with, no disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5 feet, and a bonus-action hand crossbow attack after attacking with a one-handed weapon.

name: Defensive Duelist
summary: When wielding a finesse weapon you're proficient with and hit by a melee attack, use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to AC against that attack.

name: Dual Wielder
summary: +1 AC while wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand, two-weapon fighting works with non-light one-handed weapons, and you can draw or stow two weapons at once.

name: Dungeon Delver
summary: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to find secret doors, advantage on saves against traps, resistance to trap damage, and you can search for traps at normal pace.

name: Durable
summary: +1 Constitution. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, you regain at least twice your Constitution modifier (minimum 2).

name: Elemental Adept
summary: Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to that type, and 1s on their damage dice count as 2s. Can be taken more than once.

name: Grappler
summary: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature you're grappling, and you can try to pin a grappled creature so both of you are restrained.

name: Great Weapon Master
summary: On a melee crit or a kill, make a bonus-action melee attack. Before attacking with a heavy weapon you're proficient with, you may take −5 to hit for +10 damage.

name: Healer
summary: A healer's kit can stabilize a creature and restore 1 hit point; once per rest per creature it can heal 1d6 + 4 + the creature's number of Hit Dice.

name: Heavily Armored
summary: +1 Strength. You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Heavy Armor Master
summary: +1 Strength. While in heavy armor, nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage you take is reduced by 3.

name: Inspiring Leader
summary: A 10-minute speech gives up to six friendly creatures temporary hit points equal to your level + Charisma modifier, once per short or long rest each.

name: Keen Mind
summary: +1 Intelligence. You always know north and how many hours until sunrise or sunset, and you recall anything you saw or heard within the past month.

name: Lightly Armored
summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity. You gain proficiency with light armor.

name: Linguist
summary: +1 Intelligence. Learn three languages, and you can write ciphers that others need an Intelligence check (DC = your Intelligence score + proficiency bonus) to break.

name: Lucky
summary: Three luck points per long rest: spend one to roll an extra d20 on an attack, ability check or save (and pick which to use), or to reroll an attack against you.

name: Mage Slayer
summary: Reaction melee attack against a creature within 5 feet that casts a spell, your hits impose disadvantage on concentration saves, and advantage on saves against spells cast within 5 feet.

name: Magic Initiate
summary: Pick a class (bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard): learn two of its cantrips and one 1st-level spell you can cast once per long rest.

name: Martial Adept
summary: Learn two Battle Master maneuvers and gain one d6 superiority die, regained on a short or long rest.

name: Medium Armor Master
summary: Medium armor no longer gives disadvantage on Stealth, and you can add up to +3 Dexterity (instead of +2) to AC in it.

name: Mobile
summary: +10 feet speed, Dash ignores difficult terrain, and creatures you make a melee attack against can't make opportunity attacks against you that turn.

name: Moderately Armored
summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity. You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
summary: While mounted: advantage on melee attacks against smaller unmounted creatures, redirect attacks from your mount to you, and your mount takes no damage on successful Dex saves.

name: Observant
summary: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. You can read lips, and you get +5 to passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation).

name: Polearm Master
summary: Bonus-action d4 butt-end attack with a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff or spear, and creatures entering your reach provoke an opportunity attack.

name: Resilient
summary: +1 to one ability of your choice, and you gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

name: Ritual Caster
summary: Gain a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from one class; you can cast them as rituals and copy more ritual spells you find.

name: Savage Attacker
summary: Once per turn, reroll a melee weapon attack's damage dice and use either total.

name: Sentinel
summary: Your opportunity attacks stop a creature's movement, Disengage doesn't protect from you, and you can reaction-attack a creature that attacks someone else near you.

name: Sharpshooter
summary: No disadvantage at long range, ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, and you may take −5 to hit for +10 damage with a ranged weapon.

name: Shield Master
summary: Bonus-action shield shove after attacking, add your shield's AC to Dex saves against single-target effects, and take no damage on a successful Dex save for half.

name: Skilled
summary: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

name: Skulker
summary: Hide when only lightly obscured, missing a ranged attack doesn't reveal you, and dim light doesn't give disadvantage on Perception relying on sight.

name: Spell Sniper
summary: Attack-roll spells have double range and ignore half and three-quarters cover, and you learn one attack cantrip from a class list of your choice.

name: Tavern Brawler
summary: +1 Strength or Constitution. Proficiency with improvised weapons, d4 unarmed strikes, and a bonus-action grapple after hitting with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon.

name: Tough
summary: Your hit point maximum increases by 2 for every level you have.

name: War Caster
summary: Advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentration, cast with hands full of weapons or a shield, and cast a spell as an opportunity attack.

name: Weapon Master
summary: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
